name: Chapter card: filmstrip
when: A new chapter starts. A slash wipes the card in over the last shot; one thumbnail per chapter sits on a progress line, the raised thumbnail slides from the previous chapter to this one, the big number rolls up and the title lands word by word. A second slash brings in the chapter's first shot.
anchor: The card wipes in at `in` (put it on the cut into the new chapter); the next shot wipes in at `out`.

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.number: this chapter's number (2 to 8, at most `total`); the big number rolls up from the one before
vars.total: how many chapters the video has (2 to 8): one thumbnail each, centred on the frame
vars.title: the chapter title, title case, one line of 16 characters at most (the validated length: in vice, 16 wide letters such as M and W reach the frame edge, keep those to 15)
vars.before: optional: the last shot before the card, a video file; it plays full frame and pushes in slightly until the card covers it. Empty: the project's footage shows
vars.after: the chapter's first shot, a video file: it plays in this chapter's thumbnail, then fills the frame after the second slash (from 1 s into the file)
vars.ground: the card's ground: a 1920x1080 still of this chapter blurred and dimmed to 60 %, baked with ffmpeg (no tint): ffmpeg -i shot.jpg -vf "scale=2112:1188,gblur=sigma=10:steps=3,crop=1920:1080,colorchannelmixer=rr=0.6:gg=0.6:bb=0.6" -q:v 2 ground.jpg
vars.prev_still: a full-colour 16:9 still of the previous chapter: shown on its raised thumbnail, fades out as the thumbnail drops
vars.now_still: a full-colour 16:9 still of this chapter: fades in on its thumbnail as it rises, before `after` starts playing there
vars.thumb1: chapter 1's thumbnail, a 640x360 still graded with ffmpeg. Chapters before `number` (watched): -vf "scale=640:360:flags=lanczos,eq=saturation=0.45:brightness=-0.10:contrast=0.92". This chapter and the ones after (to come): clean -vf "scale=640:360:flags=lanczos,hue=s=0,eq=brightness=-0.16:contrast=0.80"; vice -vf "scale=640:360:flags=lanczos,format=gray,format=rgb24,curves=r='0/0.22 0.5/0.55 1/0.88':g='0/0.07 0.5/0.24 1/0.55':b='0/0.08 0.5/0.2 1/0.40'". thumb2 to thumb8 the same, up to `total`
vars.in: seconds after the start: the card wipes in (0.2 s)
vars.out: seconds after the start: the next shot wipes in (0.2 s); at least 1.6 s after `in` so the title lands and reads. The scene ends 1.25 s after `out`, the shot settled

changed: The shots, the card's ground and every thumbnail are file values; the thumbnails are laid out from `total` and centred, and the number, kicker and progress follow `number` / `total`. The plum backing behind the card is gone (it never showed).
